title: Nos's Rideable Pandas
description: You can ride and/or fly pandas.
body:
Tame and ride pandas with customizable controls, permissions, and optional flying! To fly the panada you look up where you want to go.

**Features:**
  
- Taming system - Feed pandas bamboo to gain their trust
- Natural controls - Move by looking, no controls needed to fly up or decend
- Optional flying mode with permission support
- Permission-based access (all players need to feed the pandas to ride them, even oped people)
- Fully customizable - The taming system, controls, and messages are fully customizable.
- Easy to use - Just feed the panda bamboo and right-click it to start riding!
Perfect for adding unique transportation to your server!
